sentences.en: Yesterday, I cooked a meal for my family.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我为家人做了一顿饭。

sentences.en: First, I took some rice from the bag.
sentences.zh: 首先，我从袋子里拿了一些米。

sentences.en: I put the rice in a pot with water.
sentences.zh: 我把米和水放进锅里。

sentences.en: Then I cut some meat and vegetables with a knife.
sentences.zh: 然后我用刀切了一些肉和蔬菜。

sentences.en: I used a little oil for cooking.
sentences.zh: 我用了一点油来烹饪。

sentences.en: I put the meat and vegetables in the pan.
sentences.zh: 我把肉和蔬菜放进平底锅里。

sentences.en: The food on the fire was ready in twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 火上的食物二十分钟就好了。

sentences.en: I put the rice on a plate and the meat in a bowl.
sentences.zh: 我把米饭放在盘子里，肉放在碗里。

sentences.en: The meal was better than I thought.
sentences.zh: 这顿饭比我想象的要好。

sentences.en: My mother said it was very good.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈说非常好吃。

sentences.en: I was happy because everyone was pleased.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴因为每个人都很满意。

sentences.en: Cooking is not as hard as I thought.
sentences.zh: 做饭没有我想的那么难。

sentences.en: I put some butter and cheese on the bread.
sentences.zh: 我在面包上放了一些黄油和奶酪。

sentences.en: The food had a sweet taste because of the sugar.
sentences.zh: 因为加了糖，食物有甜味。

sentences.en: I added a little salt to make the taste better.
sentences.zh: 我加了一点盐让味道更好。

sentences.en: The acid taste of the lemon made my mouth pucker.
sentences.zh: 柠檬的酸味让我的嘴都酸了。

sentences.en: I stored the soup in a tin pot.
sentences.zh: 我把汤存放在锡罐里。

sentences.en: The water was boiling, so I put the eggs in.
sentences.zh: 水沸腾了，所以我把鸡蛋放了进去。

sentences.en: I used oil to cook the vegetables.
sentences.zh: 我用油炒蔬菜。

sentences.en: I made a paste from water and flour.
sentences.zh: 我用水和面粉做了糊。

sentences.en: A mixed salad has many different vegetables.
sentences.zh: 混合沙拉里有很多不同的蔬菜。
